svg.title: example-community’s GitHub constellation
svg.desc: Organization universe. 70 nodes, 180 bounded connections. Contributor diamonds connect through shared projects; project and technology views show repository relationships. Contributor size reflects represented repository count. 48 repositories discovered; 48 matching filters; 32 represented directly; 16 through era systems; 0 omitted. Contributor visualization represents the selected organization scope: 48/48 repositories scanned, up to 25 contributors per repository. Contributor totals are current; historical views filter project creation dates, not contributor tenure.
